title: People named in the case files, in other organizations’ records
question: Do the people the case files name appear as directors, officers or owners of organizations those cases do not mention?
finding: 72 names from the case files were searched in the contract notices and the tax returns. 5 appear at an organization their case does not name, in 11 person-and-organization pairs; 0 pairs carried the same three-part name as the case file; the rest are the name alone.
how: Each person listed as an actor in a case file was matched by first and last name to the notices and to Part VII of funded organizations’ returns. Organizations already named anywhere in the text of a case that names the person are left out. A second key is recorded only when the notice carries the same three-part name as the case file.
limits: Being on a board is not a finding, and most rows show ordinary civic seats. Rows without a second key may be another person of the same name. Notices carry old lists, so a date range can outlast the seat.
